overview.text: Stacker News is a public link-and-discussion community organized into territories, including jobs, AI, development and Bitcoin. Its FAQ describes Lightning-based zaps, daily rewards and referrals. Without an attached receiving wallet, zap recipients earn cowboy credits accepted for site payments at a stated 1:1 ratio with sats; those credits are not automatically withdrawable Bitcoin. Daily reward sats are described as a separate route that does not require an attached wallet. Posting and commenting can incur territory-dependent fees. Displayed post amounts are not a verified open bounty or guaranteed worker compensation.
